declaration.question: With 150 architectures to train, which sampling design recovers the exact Pareto front best, measured by igd_plus?
declaration.rope_source: 3 designs x 20 seeds at a budget of 150 architectures, pooled within design so real differences between them are removed (3 configurations x 20 seeds)
declaration.notes: The front is exact because every architecture under the ceiling was trained, so this is a loss against ground truth rather than a comparison between samples. Uniform random is the floor: the campaign used maximin, and a comparison that omitted the floor would be an author grading their own choice.

rope.source: 3 designs x 20 seeds at a budget of 150 architectures, pooled within design so real differences between them are removed (3 configurations x 20 seeds)
rope.description: 0.000657099 on igd_plus, from 0.5x the standard deviation of 60 replicates of 3 designs x 20 seeds at a budget of 150 architectures, pooled within design so real differences between them are removed (3 configurations x 20 seeds) (mean 0.00947172, sd 0.0013142, range 0.00995958)
rope.why: Derived from repeated measurements under identical conditions, so it is the floor below which no claim about architecture can be made: that much movement happens with nothing changed.
